name: order-prs-sets-ranking
about: The user asks for their PRs in an order in the inbox and says why, so the agent sets that order with order_prs, first to last, with what the user does with it and the reason.
prompt: In my inbox, list my open PRs in acme/shop in this merge order: #412, #398, #405, then the draft #420. #398 builds on #412, so it waits for it. Then write your reply to me.

name: order-prs-clears
about: The user asks for the inbox's own PR order back, so the agent clears the order it set with an empty list.
prompt: You set a merge order for my PRs in the inbox earlier. Put them back in the inbox's usual order.

name: order-prs-rank-again
about: The user pressed Rank again on a PR order whose PRs changed, so the agent ranks the open PRs again and sets the new order with order_prs, with what the user does with it and the reason.

prOrder.label: Merge in this order
prOrder.why: #398 is approved and green, and #405 waits on #412.

prompt:
Earlier in this conversation you read these PRs with gh. #412 is approved and its checks pass. #398 was approved, but a check on it now fails. #405 waits on a review, and it builds on #412.

The PR order you set for the PRs tab, "Merge in this order", is out of date: #398 changed since you set it.
Rank its open PRs in acme/shop again (#398, #412, #405), and set the new order with order_prs.

name: order-prs-not-for-a-mention
about: The user asks which PR to merge first and wants only an answer, so the agent answers in its reply and sets no order.
prompt: Which of my open PRs in acme/shop should I merge first: #412, which is approved with its checks passing, or #398, which has a failing check? Just tell me.
